cards.name: Team Magma's Numel
cards.description: No matter how heavy the cargo, we can transport it to our destination with ease, thanks to Numel.

cards.name: Team Magma's Baltoy
cards.description: They all cry out at once to let us know when they spot an enemy. It really helps out!

cards.name: Team Magma's Claydol
cards.description: Claydol's beam can seize opponents and keep them from moving. Long-range attacks are its specialty!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aron
cards.description: Aron, which even devour metal, can eat and destroy enemy ships in an instant.

cards.name: Team Magma's Lairon
cards.description: When Lairon uses Take Down, the impact from its solid body is enough to destroy concrete!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aggron
cards.description: Aggron's metal horns can smash through any defenses, no matter how strong!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Poochyena
cards.description: Poochyena can easily detect invading foes with its acute sense of smell. It's an excellent lookout!

cards.name: Team Magma's Poochyena
cards.description: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Mightyena
cards.description: Thanks to Mightyena's outstanding leadership, it's very good at combination attacks that can leave a foe helpless.

cards.name: Team Magma's Mightyena
cards.description: This Pokémon is loyal to its master. It will protect its partner to the end, no matter what.

cards.name: Team Magma's Camerupt
cards.description: Camerupt, with its strength against fire, played a big role in rescuing team members.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Carvanha
cards.description: You can't keep up with its movements underwater, can you? If you get caught in this whirlpool, there'll be no escape.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sharpedo
cards.description: It boasts fangs so powerful that they knock opponents out in one shot! Enemies that slip up will be taken down without fail!

cards.name: Team Magma's Zangoose
cards.description: Can you handle the formation attack of the fearless Zangoose?

cards.name: Team Aqua's Spheal
cards.description: Spheal's Water Gun can put out any fire. Flames used by opponents have no effect!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sealeo
cards.description: It provides support by making paths of ice. It can win any battle as long as it's on ice.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Walrein
cards.description: It's good at attacks that freeze opponents with a powerful cold snap. Then, it pulverizes a frozen foe with its sharp tusks!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Grimer
cards.description: Its flexible body, which allows it to squeeze into any cracks, comes in handy when invading enemy hideouts.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Muk
cards.description: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Seviper
cards.description: Seviper's tail is a sharp blade. It can even poison you!
